rows.quote: Instrumental variables for each protein were then extracted from the Endometrial Cancer Association Consortium (ECAC) GWAS summary data excluding UK Biobank participants (12,270 cases and 46,126 controls of European ancestry).21 We used either inverse variance weighted (IVW) models for proteins instrumented with ≥2 variants or the Wald ratio for proteins instrumented with one variant to estimate the association between protein biomarkers and endometrial cancer risk.
rows.dataset_named_in_source: Endometrial Cancer Association Consortium (ECAC) GWAS summary data excluding UK Biobank participants
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the ECAC GWAS excluding UK Biobank (reference 21, O'Mara 2018, doi 10.1038/s41467-018-05427-7; 12,270 cases, 46,126 controls); the dictionary has no endometrial cancer row and no row with that source.

rows.quote: Genetic variants associated with proteins were identified from the UKB-PPP GWAS summary data (n = 52,363 individuals, 95% European ancestries).13 We selected variants within the gene region encoding each protein (cis variants).
rows.reference_quote: Sun B.B. Chiou J. Traylor M. Plasma proteomic associations with genetics and health in the UK Biobank Nature 622 2023 329 338 37794186 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6 PMC10567551
rows.coder_note: The sentence attributes the UKB-PPP GWAS summary data to reference 13 (Sun 2023, doi 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6, four dictionary rows) and gives n = 52,363, the sample size of the full-cohort row only (rule E). The CHARGE + UK Biobank CRP GWAS in other passages is a separate dataset and does not conflict.
